input.method: 512 deterministic positions: 16 critical-pose neighbours, 128 orbit points (4/12/24/64 km), 256 Halton terrain points in [-24,24] km, 112 coast probes (28 z values, x offsets -.05/.05/-3/-12 km). CPU references only; GPU requires the standalone page button.
input.cpuPrecision: Shared CPU terrain implementation: explicit f32 arithmetic where implemented, integer hash, JavaScript Math.pow/transcendentals with binary64 evaluation. Not a pure Float64 terrain model or a promise of bitwise GPU equality. Radial sphere geometry is binary64.
input.coordinatePrecision: All GPU input xyz values are quantized to f32 before CPU height evaluation; vec4 storage stride16 bytes. Clamp outputs are also quantized to f32 before the radial-clearance reference.
input.units: Kilometres; terrainHeight is altitude above sea sphere, origin y is cloud-local with sea datum -4 km.

method: Standalone compute of the exact current and historical WGSL sources in separate pipelines. Current height compared with shared CPU implementation at identical f32 coordinates. Historical sin height is raw GPU output only; no old CPU accuracy claim. Radial clearances use CPU binary64 sphere geometry at quantized camera coordinates, not GPU intersection/length readback. No performance or photographic qualification.
toleranceQualification: Inspection threshold only; not a universal GPU error bound or proof over unsampled terrain.
